args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 after deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production version was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
